text: LABT, Sarantis's own words: played wrong, it went to a good high. Entered on the VWAP / 9 EMA setup; exited on the same setup when price was closing under VWAP and the EMA; it then pushed higher. Should have done what he usually does: set the trade up and walk away. Needs to trust his gut a little more. Facts (IBKR): buy 0.5193 at 16:39, sell 0.4614 at 16:56 (-6.77 net); the 16:55 5-min bar closed 0.4517 under VWAP and 9 EMA and made the low 0.43; the 17:00 bar closed 0.53 back above both; high 0.96 at 17:25-17:30 SAST.
